column7: The Council accepted both challenges and declared this law not in force. It found that the procedure for issuing the law was not followed, so the President's one-month period to issue it had not run out and the law had not come into force by operation of law when it was published, contrary to Article 57 of the Constitution; it therefore did not rule on the law's content. Printed in the Official Gazette, issue 23 of 22 May 2025, pages 1329 to 1337. (Unofficial translation; the Arabic is official.)
